title: His routine
grammar: Simple Present (he / she / it) + have / has + always, usually, sometimes, never
today: Hoje você vai aprender a contar a rotina de outra pessoa: o que ele ou ela faz, o que tem e com que frequência. Fofoca de vizinho, a gente adora!
canDo: Contar a rotina de alguém: she works, he goes
Negar com doesn't e perguntar com Does she…?
Usar has e always / usually / sometimes / never

video.context: Crianças de verdade contam o que a mãe e o pai fazem no trabalho. Uma delas tem uma resposta bem inesperada sobre o "trabalho de verdade".
video.predict: Antes de ouvir: que trabalhos você acha que as crianças vão falar? Médico, professor, enfermeira…?

questions.q: What do the kids talk about?
Kid: "My mom doesn't go to work. She…"

lines.text: Tony has a new mystery: Jenny, from apartment 12.
**So**, now Jenny always goes to sleep at 8 AM.
And she wakes up at 4 PM. Every day! Is she a vampire?
Rosa, does Jenny work?
Yes, she does! She's a nurse. She works at Orlando Hospital.
She usually works at night, from Monday to Thursday. She helps people.
**Oh, I see!** She doesn't go to sleep at night. She isn't a vampire!
**OK**, I never go to apartment 12 in the morning now. I'm gonna go at 5 PM!

options: Jenny goes to sleep at 8 AM. Is she a vampire?
Rosa: "She's a nurse. She works at night."
Jenny is gonna go to a new apartment
Tony is gonna be a nurse

chunks.chunk: she works at… / she helps people
chunks.pt: ela trabalha em… / ela ajuda as pessoas
chunks.tip: Lugar de trabalho: works at + lugar (at Orlando Hospital). She helps people = ela ajuda as pessoas.

practice.pt: O Sam trabalha na Sunny Bakery.
alt: Sam works at the Sunny Bakery

practice.pt: A Rosa trabalha no Sunset Building.
practice.en: Rosa works at the Sunset Building

chunks.tip: Olha a pegadinha: in THE morning, mas at night (sem the).
examples: She doesn't go to sleep at night.
I never go to apartment 12 in the morning now.

practice.en: She goes to sleep in the morning

alt: He does not work at night

chunks.chunk: she works / she doesn't work / he has
chunks.pt: ela trabalha / ela não trabalha / ele tem
chunks.tip: Com he, she, it o verbo ganha -s: work → works, wake up → wakes up. Go ganha -es: goes. Have vira has. No negativo, o -s vai pro doesn't e o verbo volta ao normal: she doesn't go.
examples: And she wakes up at 4 PM.
She doesn't go to sleep at night.

alt: Tony wakes up at seven thirty
Rosa does not wake up at 5
Rosa doesn't wake up at five

chunks.chunk: Does she…? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
chunks.tip: Pergunta com he, she, it começa com Does, e o verbo fica sem -s: Does Jenny work? (nada de "Does Jenny works?").
examples: Does she go to sleep at night? No, she doesn't.

practice.pt: A Jenny trabalha à noite? Sim.
practice.en: Does Jenny work at night? Yes, she does

practice.pt: O Tony vai dormir à noite? Não.
practice.en: Does Tony go to sleep at night? No, he doesn't
alt: Does Tony go to sleep at night? No, he does not

chunks.tip: Essas palavrinhas vêm ANTES do verbo: She always goes… / She usually works… / I never go… E o verbo continua com -s pra he/she.
examples: Jenny always goes to sleep at 8 AM.
She usually works at night, from Monday to Thursday.
I never go to apartment 12 in the morning now.

practice.en: I never go to sleep at 8
alt: I never go to sleep at eight
She always wakes up at six

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: Does she work? Yes, she does.
grammar.tip: He/she/it: verbo + s. Mas no doesn't e no Does…? o -s some: She doesn't works ❌ → She doesn't work ✅. Does she has? ❌ → Does she have? ✅

writing.prompt: Em português: escreva 2–3 frases sobre a rotina de uma pessoa da sua família: onde ela trabalha, a que horas acorda e uma coisa que ela nunca faz (ou não faz).
writing.model: My mom is a nurse. She works at night. She wakes up at 3 PM. She never goes jogging, and she doesn't work on Sunday.

gossips.title: Max's Secret Lunch

lines.text: Max usually eats at 7 PM. But this week, Max doesn't eat.
Max! Are you sick?
Carlos, Max isn't sick. Every day at 12, he goes to apartment 101.
Tony's apartment?!
Tony always has pizza at 12. And Max eats pizza with Tony!
Tony! Max doesn't eat pizza! He's a dog!
**Well**… he does now. Pepperoni is his favorite.
**So** now Tony never has pizza with Max. Max is sad, but he eats at 7 again.

options: Tony never has pizza with Max now
Max goes to a new house

questions.q: Every day at 12, Max goes to…

retell.prompt: Reconte a fofoca com as suas palavras. Comece com: "The story is about…"

gossips.read: Max usually [[eats]] at 7 PM. But this week, Max [[doesn't|does not]] eat. Carlos: Max! Are you sick? Rosa: Carlos, Max isn't sick. Every day at 12, he [[goes]] to apartment 101. Carlos: Tony's apartment?! Rosa: Tony always [[has]] pizza at 12. And Max eats pizza with Tony! Carlos: Tony! Max [[doesn't|does not]] eat pizza! He's a dog! Tony: **Well**… he does now. Pepperoni is his favorite. **So** now Tony never has pizza with Max. Max is sad, but he eats at 7 again.

gossips.title: Sam's Saturday Secret

lines.text: Every Saturday, Sam wakes up at 6:30. **Wow**. He usually wakes up at 11!
Tony, does Sam have a girlfriend?
Hmm, **let me see**…
On Saturday, Tony follows Sam. Sam works at Sunny Bakery, from 7 to 11.
Sam! Is it a secret?
Yes! **Shh!** Sunday is Mom's birthday. I'm gonna buy a cake for her.
On Sunday, Rosa has a big chocolate cake. She's so happy! And Tony? Tony has cake too. **Of course**.

options: Sam wakes up at 6:30 on Saturday. A secret!
Tony follows Sam and finds the secret

realtimes.title: O mecânico sem carro
realtimes.pt: O Carlos é mecânico. Ele trabalha na Fast Car, de segunda a sábado. Ele sempre acorda às 6:30. À noite, ele vai correr com o Max. Ele não trabalha no domingo. No domingo, ele acorda às 10! O Carlos tem um cachorro, mas ele não tem carro. Um mecânico sem carro? Pois é!
realtimes.model: Carlos is a mechanic. He works at Fast Car, from Monday to Saturday. He always wakes up at 6:30. At night, he goes jogging with Max. He doesn't work on Sunday. On Sunday, he wakes up at 10! Carlos has a dog, but he doesn't have a car. A mechanic with no car? Yep!

realtimes.title: O dia da Lily
realtimes.pt: A Lily tem 8 anos. Ela vai pra escola às 7:30, de segunda a sexta. Ela sempre acorda às 6:45. Ela nunca vai dormir às 8: ela vai dormir às 9:30! A mãe dela, a Rosa, trabalha no Sunset Building. A Lily tem um gato? Não, ela não tem. Mas às vezes ela brinca com o Max!
